note: The one place Crossview keeps plan facts it can't read from the apps' records: plan names, monthly prices, and what comes with each plan. Update this file when a vendor changes a plan; nothing else in the app hardcodes them (his call, Oct 17: avoid hardcoding). Work plans have no price here, since seat prices vary: the company pays, or you type what you pay. ChatGPT Pro is sold at three prices; the price tells them apart on screen.
